summary: The customer inquired about debit card annual fee charges.

intents.keywords: Mera debit card ka annual fee Kyon Laga...please wave kar do.

issues.issue: Customer was charged an annual fee on their debit card.
issues.reason(s): The fee is a standard charge, but can be waived if minimum transaction criteria are met.

intents.actions of agent: Checked card details, explained the fee, and submitted a fee waiver request.
intents.resolution: The agent submitted a request to waive the annual fee, which will be reversed in 5 days.
